scope: Geometry-only union of all canonical-home-path-qualified map anchors and fixed continuous residual boxes plus one full-domain exploration region per supported cell. The full domain is unqualified; its first local anchor is a warm start only. No capture labels, reward selection, projection, resampling or probe-based shrinkage. Geometry assists known held-out coordinates; not globally unseen-context inference or collision-certified region interiors.
